memory_candidates.content: In this repo, contracts under .claude/context/contracts/*.md and .claude/context/index.json are SINGLE-COPY only (no mirror under .claude/extensions/core/context/). By contrast, SKILL.md files ARE dual-copied byte-identically between .claude/skills/ and .claude/extensions/core/skills/ and must be edited in lockstep, verified with `diff -q`. Confirmed by task 773's implementation (Phase 6 verification): copying the edited primary SKILL.md over the extensions/core copy after editing is a reliable way to guarantee byte-identity rather than replaying each Edit twice.

A contract that governs the ORCHESTRATOR loop itself (not a sub-agent dispatch prompt) is wired via reference-plus-inline-directive at loop-top sub-stages of skill-orchestrate-hard (a once-per-invocation preamble stage plus an every-cycle gate stage), NOT via a build_hard_mode_prompt_context contract slot, because the orchestrator's own turns have no prompt string to inject into. Its self-monitoring 'forced handoff' reuses existing dispatch/escalation paths (e.g. the churn-detection divergence-audit dispatch shape, and the standard blocker-escalation stage) plus a scalar counter piggybacked on an existing loop-guard state file, avoiding any new artifact type.
